name: I'm Gonna Be Evil
source:
She knows exactly what she wants and the world has never dared deny her. After all, she is the modern daughter of the goddess of love. 

Lady Elisse is unrelenting enough to achieve anything so long as she wills it. And being Cupid’s apprentice is not on the list.

Still, in the grand scheme of things, defiance may cost more than obedience. She found Cupid claiming his dramatic death, and she was stationed to his post as a matchmaker to save the love in the mortal world, effective immediately.

In a blink of an eye, she was bound to a role she never chose. She must carve her own path before her bitterness destroys the very love she’s meant to protect. But she has already decided: she will be the villain.

And now the question remains— Will you be the one to stand against a god? She has always gotten what she wants, but this time… the world may refuse to bend. 

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/im-gonna-be-evil]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她清楚地知道自己想要什么，世界从来不敢拒绝她。毕竟她是现代爱情女神的女儿。

埃莉丝女士毫不留情，只要她愿意，就能实现任何目标。而成为丘比特的学徒并不在名单上。

尽管如此，从长远来看，反抗的代价可能比服从更大。她发现丘比特声称他戏剧性地死亡，她被派往他的岗位上担任媒人，拯救凡间的爱情，立即生效。

转眼间，她就注定了一个她从未选择过的角色。她必须在她的痛苦摧毁她本应保护的爱情之前开辟自己的道路。但她已经决定了：她要做反派。

现在的问题仍然是——你会成为对抗神的人吗？她总是得到她想要的，但这一次……世界可能拒绝屈服。

[来自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/im-gonna-be-evil]itch.io[/url]]
